text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of a pedestrian crossover (Level 2 PXO) on Chartwell Road and Badger Drive. The PXO will provide enhanced safety for vulnerable road users and is justified based on the assessment undertaken.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of a pedestrian crossover on Chartwell Road and Badger Drive.
